name: cache-coach
description: Band above the prompt: context size, prompt-cache countdown and what to do (fine / compact / clear), with keep-warm and auto-compact-before-expiry ticks

ttlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long the main thread's prompt cache lives after a request. Claude Code's main thread uses the 1-hour cache.

leadMinutes.title: Act this many minutes before expiry
leadMinutes.description: Keep-warm pings and auto-compaction fire this long before the cache would expire.

warnAtTokens.title: Suggest compacting from (tokens)
warnAtTokens.description: Below this, compaction barely pays back.

compactAtTokens.title: Auto-compact at or above (tokens)
compactAtTokens.description: Auto-compact before cache expiry only when the context is at least this big.

keepAliveMaxHours.title: Stop keep-warm pings after (hours)
keepAliveMaxHours.description: Pings past roughly 16 hours cost more than one re-cache.

autoCompactDefault.title: Auto-compact ticked by default
autoCompactDefault.description: Each session starts with auto-compact before expiry on.
